svg.text: Original SSA-MRN backbone: ResBlock ×4 (64 ch, H×W)
(d) SSAI block (one band b, K = 4 maps)
A = Softmaxhw(G ⊙ MT), Ob = G ⊙ A
C band outputs are concatenated (C·K maps) and fused by Conv 3×3 (CK→C) in (b).
(e) Scale-mixed training of C2MS-SP (L1 + spectral loss)
inference: PAN · LMS · MS → network → projection

C = 4 bands, K = 4. ResBlock = Conv3×3 – ReLU – Conv3×3 + skip. Parameters: original SSA-MRN 426,654 + W2 2,427,264 = 2,853,918 (the projection has none). Inputs at inference: PAN P (H×W), LMS (H×W), MS (H/4×W/4).

C2MS-SP-Lite: the trained 3×3 convs factorized (backbone rank 32; W2 1×1 – depthwise 3×3 – 1×1, CP rank 384; 66% MACs) and fine-tuned 10 epochs. Unseen sensor (e.g. WV2): per-band calibration of the inputs before the network.
